ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity (white/light-grey) to 40% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white fields occupy the lateral lobes; low-intensity black pigment forms a central wedge radiating from the notch and a continuous border along the trailing edge; isolated low-intensity punctate spots (mottling) are scattered across the white lateral fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a sharp interior vertex; estimated pixel angle of 40 degrees between the primary lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; distinct macro-notches (concave pixel voids) are present on the right lobe boundary; jagged, non-linear edge profile isolated against the sky/water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a convex sweep transitioning to sharp, tapered distal tips; trailing edges follow a primarily concave trajectory toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular, low-intensity pixel groups located on the upper-mid region of the left lobe and near the distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, dark vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-mid region of the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular tissue loss/notching on the right lobe trailing edge; thickened, high-contrast textured protrusion on the far-right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant asymmetry between left and right lobe trailing edge profiles due to heavy irregular indentations on the right lobe.
